mimic.note: split is by STAY (sample index), not patient; fraction is at the cache subsample (frac<1 understates overlap because sibling stays are subsampled away)

eicu.note: split is by STAY (sample index), not patient; fraction is at the cache subsample (frac<1 understates overlap because sibling stays are subsampled away)

facts.window: first 48 hourly bins from ICU admission (intime / offset 0); stays <48h are padded after discharge
facts.inclusion: adults (age>=18), ICU LOS >= 24h (MIN_LOS_H=24), >=1 hour in which ALL hemodynamic variables observed (has_hemodynamic_window); PhysioNet: len(df)>=24 and non-empty and hemodynamic window

los_definition.physionet: len(df) hourly rows (hours from ICU admission to last record)

facts.prediction_time: end of hour 48 (or end of stay if shorter) -- outcome (LOS / in-hospital death) is NOT yet known, but for stays <48h the window already spans the whole stay
facts.normalization: MinMaxNormalizer: FIXED affine map from clinical plausibility bounds (PLAUS); fit() is a no-op; no statistics derived from any split
facts.imputation: hourly median bin; forward-fill gap limit 6h; remaining missing -> 0 with observation mask as separate input
facts.split_unit_mortality: stratified random split of STAYS (make_patient_split_loaders despite name), 80/20, seed = fine-tune seed
facts.split_unit_los: random permutation of PhysioNet-A stays (= patients), 80/20, seed = fine-tune seed
facts.repeated_admissions: no de-duplication to one stay per patient in MIMIC/eICU
